title: 100-Gb/s Multiplexing and Demultiplexing IC Operations in InP HEMT Technology
figure_number: Fig. 3. Circuit configuration of the newly designed selector IC. (a) Circuit diagram of the selector core. (b) Block diagram of the selector IC.
function_summary: flip-flop: This paper describes the 100-Gb/s multiplexing operation of a selector IC and demultiplexing operation of a D-type flip-flop (D-FF) using production-level 0.1m-gate-length InP HEMT IC technology.
